newsitem.title: RUSSIA: MGTS sees 1996 pretax profit 489 bln.
newsitem.headline: MGTS sees 1996 pretax profit 489 bln.

text.p: Russian regional telecommunications company MGTS said on Friday its preliminary pre-tax profit, according to Russian accounting standards on an accruals basis, was 489.08 billion roubles after 300.23 billion in 1995.

MGTS, which provides telecoms services in the Moscow region, expects pre-tax profit to rise to 722.29 billion roubles in 1997, according to a chart circulated during a CS First Boston investment conference.

NOTE - Sales and profit figures in billions of roubles. Phones in thousand units. Full name OAO Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set (MGTS). Figures to Russian accounting standards on accruals basis.

Russian accounting standards differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
